newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corporate debt market activity picks up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corporate debt market activity picks up.

text.p: U.S. corporate bond market saw a pickup in new issuance and trading activity on Wednesday from the sluggishness early in the week, trader said.
However, except for a few individual sectors, corporate bond prices generally tracked Treasuries in the secondary market, they added.

In the investment-grade market, spreads on bank paper widened about five basis points in anticipation that more banks will start issuing a new form of tax-advantaged preferred stock recently sanctioned by the Federal Reserve, traders said.
